headline: IBM and Duke researchers publish EXPLORE for language-model-guided analog topology exploration
fact: Guanglei Zhou, Xin Zhang and coauthors publish EXPLORE, combining an autoregressive circuit language model with Monte Carlo tree search and simulation feedback to explore analog circuit topologies. The manuscript lists Duke University, MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab and IBM Research affiliations. It concerns generating circuit structure as well as optimizing candidate designs. July 15 is the initial arXiv publication date; later MLCAD presentation is supporting context for the same research, not evidence of production adoption.
